observation.precondition: fresh D1 reaches BUILDING HEAP and then the red fail-closed frame
observation.quiet_rule: no monitor, screenshot, FTP or CPU stop before the red frame
observation.read_session: all tuple, code and data reads belong to that one stopped session

code_rule: Bind the sampled PC to bytes in the captured CPU view before assigning a symbol.
data_rule: Translate every logical data address through the captured mapping and read physical RAM; raw ROM-overlaid reads are inadmissible.

decision_rows.early-eval-or-ext-dma: PC belongs to eval_init/cell_set_a/ext_set_a/ext_dma while boot/C2/rtov status remains pre-entry; name the exact early heap instruction or DMA job.
decision_rows.boot-overlay-chain: vm_boot_overlay_status is non-OK or the stack returns through vm_install_staged_boot_overlay; name the failing boot-overlay stage.
decision_rows.runtime-family-or-convergence: rtov_fault/family or the convergence slots are non-clear; name the runtime-family, content-convergence or timeout status and its active descriptor.
decision_rows.c2-prepare-or-decode: boot overlay is OK and rtov state is healthy but c2_ready is clear; bind PC/stack to prepare, island install or pre-phase-00 decoder entry.
decision_rows.wild-control-flow: PC bytes are not owned executable product code or the stack chain exits every legal interval edge; classify control-flow corruption without inventing a source.
decision_rows.ambiguous: No product or heap-mechanism claim; return to owner with this single complete row.

claim_limit: One future stopped-state row only. This file authorizes no device contact, product fix, D1 result or D2-D5 execution.
